Definition
[Dehn surgery] \group thurston-ch01-topology Source: thurston:page-0010

Dehn surgery removes a tubular neighborhood of every component of a knot or link and glues one solid torus to each resulting boundary torus. On each boundary component, the gluing is determined by the primitive nonzero element of $\pi _1(T^2)\cong \mathbb Z\oplus \mathbb Z$ that bounds a meridian disk in the attached solid torus. Thus a link surgery has one slope per component, each defined up to sign.
